ideas.title: Investigating Obstruction of Immigration Enforcement in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential obstruction of immigration enforcement in Minnesota, including the role of Governor Tim Walz and other state officials
questions: What evidence is there of potential obstruction of justice?
What role did Governor Tim Walz and other state officials play in the alleged obstruction?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the ongoing tensions between state and federal authorities over immigration policy. I would recommend pursuing this story aggressively, using a combination of document requests and interviews with key officials.
